Application Data.NAME: Little Stars Day Care Center
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Little Stars Day Care Center provides comprehensive child care services for children aged six weeks to five years. Our facility prioritizes a safe and nurturing environment, adhering to all state-mandated licensing requirements and maintaining a staff-to-child ratio that supports individualized attention. We offer a range of educational and recreational activities tailored to foster the cognitive, emotional, and social development of each child. Our programs include outdoor play, arts and crafts, and age-appropriate learning experiences. We also operate a small kitchen where meals and snacks are prepared daily, ensuring that all food allergies are accommodated and health standards are met. Regular safety drills and health checks are conducted to minimize risks associated with injuries and illnesses.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses incurred from two incidents within the last year. The first incident occurred on 05/15/2023, when a child slipped on wet flooring during a scheduled outdoor playtime, resulting in a minor ankle sprain; this claim was settled for $5,000. The second incident took place on 08/30/2023, due to a fire incident linked to the kitchen equipment malfunction, which caused property damage valued at $10,000; this claim remains open as repairs are ongoing.

Key Risk Considerations
• Liability from child injuries or illness: Includes risks such as playground accidents, slips
and falls, allergic reactions to food, or communicable disease outbreaks. For example, a child
slipping on wet flooring and sustaining a fracture could result in a liability claim.
• Fire or property damage from cooking or heating: Many centers operate kitchens or
warming areas, increasing fire risk. An unattended stove or malfunctioning heating equipment
could cause significant property damage or injury.
